title: William Nelson Cromwell Professor of Law
bio: Jesse M. Fried is the William Nelson Cromwell Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. He is also a Fellow and Research Member of the European Corporate Governance Institute. From 2014-2024, he was the Dane Professor of Law. Before joining the Harvard faculty in 2009, Fried was a Professor of Law and Faculty Co-Director of […]
